title: Head of Product & Engineering (m/w/d)
description: Intro Die bündelt Expertise aus verschiedenen Bereichen, um Fortschritt und Innovation in der Gesundheitsversorgung voranzutreiben. Unser Zusammenschluss aus Klinik, Labor, telemedizinischem Service und IT-Unternehmen steht für die Entwicklung moderner und effektiver Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen. Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo. Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist : Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten. Du möchtest nicht nur Teams führen, sondern eine gesamte Product- und Engineering-Organisation auf das nächste Level bringen? Du verstehst es, technische Exzellenz mit einer klaren Produktstrategie zu verbinden und schaffst Strukturen, die schnelles Wachstum ermöglichen? Dann werde Teil unseres Führungsteams und gestalte die Zukunft unserer Engineering- und Produktorganisation aktiv mit. Deine Mission bei uns Engineering-Organisation neu aufstellen und skalieren: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für drei Engineering-Teams und ein Infrastruktur-Team, strukturierst Organisation, Rollen und Zusammenarbeit neu und baust Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren. Produktteam führen: Du leitest unser Product- und UI/UX-Team, entwickelst Produktstrategie und Roadmap gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung weiter und stellst sicher, dass die wichtigsten Themen zur richtigen Zeit umgesetzt werden - mit dem klaren Ziel, messbares Produktwachstum zu treiben. Product & Engineering zusammenführen: Du verzahnst Produktmanagement und Entwicklung zu einem gemeinsamen Delivery-Prozess mit klaren Prioritäten, Roadmaps und Verantwortlichkeiten. Delivery messbar beschleunigen: Dein wichtigster Erfolgsmaßstab ist die Delivery-Geschwindigkeit unserer Teams. Du identifizierst Engpässe, etablierst effiziente Planungs-, Release- und Delivery-Prozesse und steigerst den Output messbar und nachhaltig. Technische Entscheidungen begleiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Tech Leads triffst du fundierte Entscheidungen rund um Architektur, Skalierung und TechDebt und schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum. Organisation weiterentwickeln: Du verantwortest Hiring, Budget und Priorisierung für Product und Engineering und baust eine Organisation auf, die auch mit weiterem Wachstum leistungsfähig bleibt. Management & Stakeholder einbinden: Du schaffst Transparenz über Delivery, Fortschritte und Prioritäten und bist Sparringspartner für Geschäftsführung, Tech Leads und Product Team. Was du mitbringen solltest Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits mehrere Product- und Engineering Teams erfolgreich geführt und Organisationen weiterentwickelt. Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Engineering-Organisationen: Du hast Delivery-Prozesse verbessert, Strukturen geschaffen und den Output von Entwicklungsteams messbar gesteigert. Technisches Verständnis auf Augenhöhe: Du kannst technische Entscheidungen mit Tech Leads diskutieren, verstehst Architektur, Skalierung und technische Trade-offs und genießt dadurch die Akzeptanz deiner Engineering-Teams. Product-Mindset: Du verstehst, wie gute Produktentwicklung funktioniert und bringst Erfahrung im Aufbau digitaler Produkte oder Plattformen mit. Hands-on Mentalität: Du gehst Themen pragmatisch an, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich sowohl im operativen Tagesgeschäft als auch auf Management-Ebene wohl. Starkes Stakeholdermanagement: Du kommunizierst sicher mit Geschäftsführung, Produkt, Engineering und weiteren Fachbereichen und schaffst es, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen. Erfahrung im Scale-up-Umfeld: Du arbeitest gerne in dynamischen Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hast Freude daran, Organisationen aktiv mitzugestalten. Pluspunkte: Eine eigene Entwicklervergangenheit, Erfahrung mit Engineering-Metriken wie DORA oder Cycle Time sowie Kenntnisse im Plattform-, SaaS- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Was wir dir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester. Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir. Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen. Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten. Bike-Leasing: Nach erfolgreicher Probezeit hast du die Möglichkeit, ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike zu leasen. Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse. Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da. raw.title: Senior Project Turnaround Manager (Freelance, Hybrid)
raw.description:
For a complex and business-critical transformation project, we are looking for an experienced Senior Project Turnaround Manager on a freelance basis.

The role is intended to provide hands-on support during an intensive project stabilisation and recovery phase. This is not a purely advisory or moderating assignment. The Project Recovery Manager will actively develop, document and implement the structures required to stabilise the project.

The primary focus will be on establishing effective project governance, clarifying roles and responsibilities, resolving existing organisational ambiguities and defining a reliable collaboration model between the involved internal and external parties.

The Project Recovery Manager will work closely with the Senior IT Project Manager, the PMO, the Solution Architect and the responsible stakeholders.

Key Facts / Framework Conditions

  • Contract type: Freelance assignment
  • Start: As soon as possible
  • Initial duration: At least six weeks
  • Extension: Possible depending on project status and recovery progress
  • Workload: 100%
  • Working model: Hybrid
  • Onsite presence: Regular/weekly onsite presence will be required during the recovery and stabilisation phase
  • Languages: Fluent German and English are mandatory
  • Location requirement: Only candidates based in the EU can be considered for this assignment.

Tasks

  • Conduct a structured assessment of the current project organisation, governance and delivery setup
  • Identify organisational gaps, unclear responsibilities, ineffective decision paths and critical dependencies
  • Develop and implement an effective project governance model
  • Clarify project roles, responsibilities and accountabilities
  • Review existing RACI models and resolve overlaps, gaps and ambiguities
  • Document agreed roles, responsibilities and decision-making authorities
  • Define clear decision-making and escalation processes
  • Establish an effective collaboration model between internal teams, external partners and other involved parties
  • Clarify interfaces and responsibilities between the different project organisations
  • Define and document project meeting structures, governance bodies and reporting requirements
  • Prepare and facilitate focused recovery workshops
  • Translate workshop outcomes into concrete structures, decisions, actions and deliverables
  • Develop a structured recovery plan with clear priorities, owners, milestones and target dates
  • Support the resolution of critical organisational and delivery-related issues
  • Challenge existing assumptions, structures and ways of working where necessary
  • Ensure that agreed recovery measures are implemented and embedded in the project organisation
  • Track the effectiveness and progress of recovery activities
  • Support the assessment of project feasibility and go-live readiness
  • Prepare a structured handover of established governance and recovery mechanisms to the Senior IT Project Manager and PMO

Requirements

  • Several years of experience in leading project recovery, project turnaround or the stabilisation of complex transformation programmes
  • Proven hands-on experience in designing and implementing project governance structures
  • Strong experience in clarifying and documenting roles, responsibilities and decision-making authorities
  • Practical experience in reviewing, redesigning and implementing RACI models
  • Experience in defining collaboration and delivery models across internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to assess critical project situations, identify structural weaknesses and develop executable recovery measures
  • Strong workshop facilitation skills combined with the ability to translate outcomes into concrete structures, documentation and actions
  • Excellent stakeholder, conflict-management and escalation capabilities
  • Confidence in challenging existing structures, assumptions and ways of working
  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a pragmatic implementation approach
  • Ability to work independently and deliver tangible results within a short and intensive assignment period
  • Fluent German and English

This role sits at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and data. You’ll be responsible for how products and content come to life on the site to attract, engage, and convert customers.</p> <p>Beyond optimizing the onsite experience, this role will take a leading position in SEO and organic growth, leveraging content and site merchandising tools to drive awareness, discovery, and traffic. You’ll use insights and data to ensure Quince’s unique value proposition shines through every page, from homepage to product detail.</p> <p>This role will participate in shaping our growth in Germany through leveraging our global tools and processes, helping improve them and developing impactful localization strategy and tactics across web and app.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Creative, Category Management, and Engineering to ensure site merchandising supports both brand and business goals.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the end-to-end merchandising strategy for the Quince Germany website and mobile apps, ensuring a seamless and inspiring customer experience.</li> <li>Manage and optimize merchandising tools and platforms that power product discovery, personalization, and site and app performance.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Creative, and Data teams to align onsite experiences with seasonal campaigns, assortment shifts, and brand priorities.</li> <li>Partner with global teams to ensure improvements to tooling, automation, merchandising best practices can be easily adopted in the region as well as improving our key metrics.</li> <li>Use analytics and testing to continuously improve site navigation, product placement, and content engagement.</li> <li>Own site merchandising calendar and execution for key selling moments (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, data-local-id="9ae6a13b-2175-4a37-a4c2-5839b2f592ae"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Qualifications</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>12 years of experience, with at least 8 years in ecommerce, digital merchandising, site optimization, or growth/SEO, and 3 years leading a team.</li> <li>Proven track record of an end-to-end customer journey across web and app for a high-volume consumer brand.</li> <li>Experience leading a merchandising or digital experience function for an international or multi-market business and strong localization expertise.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using A/B testing, web analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel), and experimentation platforms.</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of SEO foundations: metadata, internal linking, site structure, schema marketup, crawlability.</li> dynamic environment.</li> <li>Experience leading a design-forward team that is obsessed with pixel-perfect craftsmanship.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Personalized customer experience across multiple channels.</li> <li>Fluency in German and English.&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated experience applying AI tools.</li> <li>Track record of success in fast-scaling, high-growth environments, ideally in direct-to-consumer (DTC) or omnichannel commerce.</li> <li>Familiarity with search &amp; merchandising tools (Bloomreach, Algolia), SEO platforms (Botify, Semrush), A/B testing tools (Optimizely, VWO), and product analytics tools (Looker,   • Driven by curiosity, collaboration, and growth – you enjoy learning, support others, and contribute to a positive, team-oriented project culture

While our main office is located in Heidelberg, many of our team members are based across various cities in Germany. This reflects our flexible and distributed team structure and means that relocation is not a requirement.

When not working onsite with clients, you're warmly welcome to work from our Heidelberg office or from home.

title: Solution Architect (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist eine führende Open-Commerce-Plattform, die Händler dabei unterstützt, flexible, skalierbare und zukunftssichere digitale Commerce-Erlebnisse aufzubauen. Wir arbeiten eng mit Händlern, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern zusammen, um anspruchsvolle E-Commerce-Lösungen für ambitionierte Marken zu realisieren. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Solution Architect (m/w/d) , der skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen für Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Kunden konzipiert, begleitet und validiert. Diese Rolle befindet sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen geschäftlichen Anforderungen und technischer Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Sales, Customer Success sowie Implementierungspartnern zusammen, um erfolgreiche, zukunftssichere Lösungen und termingerechte Go-Lives sicherzustellen. Als Solution Architect (m/w/d) verantwortest du das Lösungsdesign von der Pre-Sales-Phase bis hin zu den ersten Schritten nach dem Launch. Du übersetzt komplexe geschäftliche Anforderungen in klare technische Architekturen und stellst sicher, dass diese mit den Möglichkeiten der Plattform, bewährten Best Practices und den Delivery-Modellen unserer Partner übereinstimmen. Solution Design & Architektur Durchführung umfassender technischer Discovery-Workshops, um Geschäftsmodelle, Anforderungen, Rahmenbedingungen und Erfolgskriterien der Kunden zu verstehen. Konzeption ganzheitlicher E-Commerce-Architekturen, einschließlich der Konfiguration der Kernplattform, Integrationen, individueller Erweiterungen und Drittanbietertechnologien. Definition von Architekturmustern, Datenflüssen und Integrationsstrategien unter Berücksichtigung von Best Practices hinsichtlich Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit. Bewertung von Vor- und Nachteilen individueller Entwicklungen gegenüber Standardfunktionen der Plattform. Unterstützung bei der Implementierung Tätigkeit als primäre technische Ansprechperson während des Implementierungsprozesses und Unterstützung von Partnern bei Entwicklung, Integrationen und Go-Lives. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb bei Vertriebsstrategien, der Definition von Projektumfängen, Aufwandsschätzungen und Risikobewertungen. Verständliche Vermittlung technischer Konzepte, Annahmen und Rahmenbedingungen an technische sowie geschäftliche Stakeholder auf Management-Ebene. Unterstützung bei Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) und technischen Validierungen bei Bedarf. Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern & Delivery-Teams Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen und Systemintegrationspartnern (SI-Partnern), um Lieferansätze zu validieren und die architektonische Ausrichtung sicherzustellen. Überprüfung von Lösungsdesigns und Implementierungsplänen der Partner hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Plattformstandards und Best Practices. Unterstützung während des Onboardings sowie in den frühen Projektphasen, um reibungslose Kunden-Launches sicherzustellen. Frühzeitige Identifikation und Minimierung technischer Risiken im Projektverlauf. Plattform- & Ökosystem-Expertise Aufbau und Pflege eines tiefgehenden Verständnisses der E-Commerce-Plattform, ihrer Produkt-Roadmap sowie relevanter Ökosystem-Technologien. Kontinuierliche Beobachtung von Markttrends, neuen Technologien und sich weiterentwickelnden Architekturmustern. Weitergabe von Kunden- und Partnerfeedback an die Produkt- und Engineering-Teams zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Plattform. Erfolgskennzahlen (KPIs) Erfolgreiche und termingerechte Kunden-Launches. Hohe Qualität, Zukunftsfähigkeit und Skalierbarkeit der entwickelten Lösungsarchitekturen. Hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sowie Zufriedenheit der Partner während und nach der Implementierung. Reduzierung technischer Risiken und Verringerung von Nacharbeiten im Verlauf der Implementierung. Das bringst du mit: Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich E-Commerce-Architektur, Solution Consulting oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle. Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch. Tiefgehendes Verständnis moderner E-Commerce-Architekturen sowie gängiger Integrationsmuster. Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Lösungen mit Anbindungen an Payment-, ERP-, PIM-, CMS-, Such- und Marketing-Technologien . Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte verständlich an technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder zu vermitteln. Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten zur Zusammenarbeit mit Teams aus Vertrieb, Delivery und Partner-Management. Besonders vorteilhaft: Erfahrung mit führenden E-Commerce-Plattformen. Erfahrung in einem partnergetriebenen oder agenturbasierten Delivery-Umfeld. Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Enterprise-Kunden oder Kunden aus dem gehobenen Mid-Market-Segment. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr! Wir arbeiten eng mit Händlern, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern zusammen, um anspruchsvolle E-Commerce-Lösungen für ambitionierte Marken zu realisieren.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Solution Architect (m/w/d), der skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen für Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Kunden konzipiert, begleitet und validiert. Diese Rolle befindet sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen geschäftlichen Anforderungen und technischer Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Sales, Customer Success sowie Implementierungspartnern zusammen, um erfolgreiche, zukunftssichere Lösungen und termingerechte Go-Lives sicherzustellen.

Als Solution Architect (m/w/d) verantwortest du das Lösungsdesign von der Pre-Sales-Phase bis hin zu den ersten Schritten nach dem Launch. Du übersetzt komplexe geschäftliche Anforderungen in klare technische Architekturen und stellst sicher, dass diese mit den Möglichkeiten der Plattform, bewährten Best Practices und den Delivery-Modellen unserer Partner übereinstimmen.


  • Solution Design & Architektur

    • Durchführung umfassender technischer Discovery-Workshops, um Geschäftsmodelle, Anforderungen, Rahmenbedingungen und Erfolgskriterien der Kunden zu verstehen.

    • Konzeption ganzheitlicher E-Commerce-Architekturen, einschließlich der Konfiguration der Kernplattform, Integrationen, individueller Erweiterungen und Drittanbietertechnologien.

    • Definition von Architekturmustern, Datenflüssen und Integrationsstrategien unter Berücksichtigung von Best Practices hinsichtlich Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit.

    • Bewertung von Vor- und Nachteilen individueller Entwicklungen gegenüber Standardfunktionen der Plattform.

  • Unterstützung bei der Implementierung

    • Tätigkeit als primäre technische Ansprechperson während des Implementierungsprozesses und Unterstützung von Partnern bei Entwicklung, Integrationen und Go-Lives.

    • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb bei Vertriebsstrategien, der Definition von Projektumfängen, Aufwandsschätzungen und Risikobewertungen.

    • Verständliche Vermittlung technischer Konzepte, Annahmen und Rahmenbedingungen an technische sowie geschäftliche Stakeholder auf Management-Ebene.

    • Unterstützung bei Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) und technischen Validierungen bei Bedarf.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern & Delivery-Teams

    • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen und Systemintegrationspartnern (SI-Partnern), um Lieferansätze zu validieren und die architektonische Ausrichtung sicherzustellen.

    • Überprüfung von Lösungsdesigns und Implementierungsplänen der Partner hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Plattformstandards und Best Practices.

    • Unterstützung während des Onboardings sowie in den frühen Projektphasen, um reibungslose Kunden-Launches sicherzustellen.

    • Frühzeitige Identifikation und Minimierung technischer Risiken im Projektverlauf.

  • Plattform- & Ökosystem-Expertise

    • Aufbau und Pflege eines tiefgehenden Verständnisses der E-Commerce-Plattform, ihrer Produkt-Roadmap sowie relevanter Ökosystem-Technologien.

    • Kontinuierliche Beobachtung von Markttrends, neuen Technologien und sich weiterentwickelnden Architekturmustern.

    • Weitergabe von Kunden- und Partnerfeedback an die Produkt- und Engineering-Teams zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Plattform.

  • Erfolgskennzahlen (KPIs)

    • Erfolgreiche und termingerechte Kunden-Launches.

    • Hohe Qualität, Zukunftsfähigkeit und Skalierbarkeit der entwickelten Lösungsarchitekturen.

    • Hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sowie Zufriedenheit der Partner während und nach der Implementierung.

    • Reduzierung technischer Risiken und Verringerung von Nacharbeiten im Verlauf der Implementierung.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich E-Commerce-Architektur, Solution Consulting oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle.

  • Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis moderner E-Commerce-Architekturen sowie gängiger Integrationsmuster.

  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Lösungen mit Anbindungen an Payment-, ERP-, PIM-, CMS-, Such- und Marketing-Technologien.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte verständlich an technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder zu vermitteln.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten zur Zusammenarbeit mit Teams aus Vertrieb, Delivery und Partner-Management.

Besonders vorteilhaft:

  • Erfahrung mit führenden E-Commerce-Plattformen.

  • Erfahrung in einem partnergetriebenen oder agenturbasierten Delivery-Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Enterprise-Kunden oder Kunden aus dem gehobenen Mid-Market-Segment.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Rudenko und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

title: Head of Customer Support (m/w/d)
description: Für Menschen, die Service nicht verwalten, sondern prägen. Support wird oft unterschätzt. Dabei entscheidet genau dieser Moment darüber, wie sich eine Zusammenarbeit anfühlt. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert. Wenn eine Frage auftaucht. Wenn ein Hotel einfach jemanden braucht, der zuhört, versteht und eine Lösung findet. Genau dort beginnt unsere Arbeit. Wir sind HotelNetSolutions aus Berlin. Seit 2006 entwickeln wir Software für die Hotellerie. Keine Software von der Stange, sondern Lösungen, die sich den Hotels anpassen und nicht umgekehrt. Mit OnePageBooking, VoucherBooking, RateDistributor und der MultiPropertyView unterstützen wir heute mehr als 2.200 Hotels und Hotelgruppen dabei, mehr Direktbuchungen zu erzielen und ihre Persönlichkeit auch im Internet erlebbar zu machen. Wir glauben nicht an anonyme Tickets. Wir glauben an Beziehungen. An Erreichbarkeit. An das gesprochene Wort. Und daran, dass guter Support weit mehr ist als die Antwort auf eine Frage. Deshalb suchen wir keinen Verwalter. Wir suchen einen Head of Customer Support, der Menschen entwickelt, Prozesse hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit seinem Team dafür sorgt, dass aus jedem Kontakt ein gutes Gefühl entsteht. Aufgaben Du führst unser internationales Customer Support Team mit Klarheit, Vertrauen und einem offenen Ohr. Du schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und ihr Wissen miteinander teilen. Du erkennst, wo Prozesse haken, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du unseren Support kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität kein Zufall ist. Du behältst Kennzahlen im Blick, ohne dabei den Menschen dahinter zu vergessen. Denn jede Zahl erzählt eine Geschichte. Man muss nur genau hinsehen. Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Vertrieb zusammen. Kundenfeedback landet bei dir nicht in einer Schublade, sondern dort, wo Produkte besser werden. Auch wenn es einmal kompliziert wird, bleibst du ruhig. Du begleitest Eskalationen mit Souveränität und findest Lösungen, die langfristig tragen. Qualifikation Du hast bereits ein Customer Support oder Customer Success Team geführt und weißt, dass gute Führung nicht bedeutet, auf jede Frage selbst die Antwort zu kennen. Du hast Freude daran, Menschen wachsen zu sehen und ihnen den Rücken freizuhalten. Idealerweise kennst du die Hotellerie oder ein Softwareunternehmen, das erklärungsbedürftige Produkte betreut. Du verstehst, wie wichtig verlässlicher Support für den Alltag unserer Kunden ist. Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und triffst Entscheidungen mit Ruhe und Augenmaß. Du kommunizierst klar, wertschätzend und verbindlich. Auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1 Niveau. Englisch hilft dir im internationalen Austausch. Vor allem aber hast du Lust, Dinge besser zu machen. Nicht weil es im Prozesshandbuch steht, sondern weil du weißt, dass guter Service den Unterschied macht. Benefits Ein guter Support entsteht nicht durch Prozesse allein. Er entsteht durch Menschen, die sich gegenseitig vertrauen. Die gerne zusammenarbeiten. Die auch an stressigen Tagen miteinander lachen. Genau so arbeiten wir. Dich erwartet ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, Wissen teilt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet. Ehrlich gesagt finden wir sogar, dass es das beste Team aller Zeiten ist. Wahrscheinlich sagen das viele. Wir meinen es wirklich. Wir suchen Menschen, die bleiben möchten. Deshalb erhältst du einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und eine langfristige Perspektive in einem inhabergeführten Unternehmen, in dem Zuverlässigkeit nicht nur auf der Website steht, sondern gelebt wird. Treue soll sich lohnen. Deshalb wächst mit der Zeit auch dein Urlaubsanspruch. Nach Feierabend ist Feierabend. Unsere Arbeitszeiten sind montags bis freitags geregelt. Überstunden kannst du in Freizeit umwandeln. Das Wochenende gehört dir. Zwei Tage Home Office. Drei Tage gemeinsam im Büro. Für uns die richtige Mischung aus konzentriertem Arbeiten und persönlichem Austausch. Unser Berliner Loft im Tiergarten hat den Charme eines echten Hinterhofs. Keine Hochglanzbüros. Dafür kurze Wege, offene Türen und Menschen, die man gerne trifft. Dresscode? Komm so, wie du dich wohlfühlst. Hoodie funktioniert bei uns genauso gut wie Hemd. Mitreden gehört bei uns dazu. Bei großen Entscheidungen genauso wie bei der Frage, welche Süßigkeiten als Nächstes im Büro landen. Und weil Zusammenarbeit mehr ist als Meetings, verbringen wir auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags gerne Zeit miteinander. Mal auf der Spree. Mal beim Bowling. Und manchmal einfach bei unserer inzwischen legendären Kuchenparty. Du bist startklar und willst endlich loslegen? Dann nichts wie los – wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: SVP, Data & Tech Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>2830 - SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><em>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective, bringing together the best platforms, people, and partners to create limitless opportunities for growth in a world where media is Everywhere.&nbsp; </em></p> <p>This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.</p> <p><strong>SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead</strong></p> <p>As the Global Client Data &amp; Tech Lead, you will take ownership of driving data-led transformation for one of WPP’s largest and most ambitious global clients. You will be at the forefront of enabling data, technology, and AI to create more impactful brand experiences and measurable business growth.</p> <p>You will be a strategic partner to WPP Media’s Global Client Leads, defining what ‘data-driven’ marketing looks like for your client across Discovery, Planning, Activation, and Measurement. You will act as a senior advisor to CMOs and other key stakeholders and will guide them in building the data capabilities and infrastructure needed to achieve their marketing goals while ensuring responsible and effective use of data.</p> <p>This role demands a leader who can combine thought leadership, operational expertise, strong line management, and a deep understanding of data and technology to deliver tangible results. You will assemble and lead a team of experts to implement strategies, deploy solutions, and build long-term capability for your client.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Client Data Narrative &amp; Drive Growth:</strong> Build strategic relationships with key client stakeholders, including CMOs, IT, and Finance leaders. Develop a deep understanding of client objectives and advise on how data, technology, and AI can drive impact and growth. Act as a trusted advisor, helping clients navigate complex challenges and opportunities in data-driven marketing. Partner with the Global Account Director/Client President to co-create and execute the Global Client Growth Plan.</li> <li><strong>Data Strategy Expertise:</strong> Assemble and lead a team of data strategists to define the role of data for media and advertising on the client business. Define how first-party data should be collected, organized, and deployed across business units. Identify and execute data partnerships to enrich and extend first-party data. Standardize data usage across markets and business units to achieve marketing objectives.</li> <li><strong>Measurement &amp; Optimization Frameworks:</strong> Oversee the design and implementation of measurement frameworks that balance short- and long-term value creation. Define growth targets and metrics for marketing effectiveness. Define and deploy use of data science techniques to better predict growth from audience-based, omnichannel approaches. Introduce AI-powered optimization tools to enhance efficiency and performance within and across channels. Ensure timely and actionable reporting for visibility into performance.</li> <li><strong>Technology Consulting and Implementation</strong>: Assemble and lead a team to evaluate clients’ technology ecosystems and recommend improvements to enhance performance and reduce costs. Oversee the implementation of cloud data management, martech, adtech, AI, and analytics systems. Integrate WPP Data, Tech, and media solutions into the client’s broader technology stack to accelerate results.</li> <li><strong>Capability Building and Education</strong>: Educate WPP client teams on WPP’s data capabilities, tools, and priorities. Provide visible leadership, coaching, and mentorship to inspire teams and foster innovation in data, technology, and AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevant industry experience, including significant time in an agency environment.</li> <li>Proven experience operating at a senior client leadership level or engaging with high-profile stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated thought leadership and expertise in data, technology, and AI within the marketing industry.</li> <li>A track record of solving complex problems and delivering measurable business success through data-driven strategies.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, clients, and colleagues positively.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, capable of simplifying complex concepts for diverse audiences.</li> <li>Experience building and managing large, diverse teams of data, technology, and analytics specialists.</li> <li>Strategic and operational agility, with the ability to adapt quickly in dynamic environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when&nbsp;we're&nbsp;together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;That's&nbsp;why&nbsp;we’ve&nbsp;adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp; Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns.</p> <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong></p> <p>The Business Director will oversee media campaigns with support from more junior planners and assist the Client Lead in ensuring our work is delivered to the highest quality. They will be responsible for elevating our agency's strategic planning function through a robust, data-first approach. This role is key to integrating advanced analytical capabilities with creative strategic development, ensuring our recommendations are always evidence-based and ahead of the curve. The Business Director has oversight and responsibility for the day-to-day management of media plans, working to fulfill the client’s media strategy in the context of changing market conditions. They are responsible for ensuring investment is optimal to deliver campaign objectives, via effective planning.</p> <p><strong>Our clients:</strong></p> <p>We work across the EE/BT group.&nbsp; Although their public faces are very different, the two brands are managed very closely together.&nbsp; They’re one of the nation’s biggest spenders, and some of our most-loved brands.&nbsp; They are genuinely important to the nation with their creation and management of the UK’s connectivity networks, and we reflect that importance with how we try to help consumers and give them useful solutions in a modern world.</p> <p><strong>Our team:</strong></p> <p>Team Connect is a very big team that is 100% allocated to EE, BT and Plusnet.&nbsp; A successful candidate can expect to work on multiple aspects of these brands. This includes broadband, mobile, TV, as well as Masterbrand. This role is purely Brand focused but will involve close collaboration with Performance planners.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Essential Functions/Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain fantastic relationships with key clients in media and marketing teams.</li> <li>Ensure the delivery of high-quality response presentations, actionable weekly reporting, insightful post campaign analyses and clear briefs to Activation.</li> <li>Deliver clear and compelling rationale to support media investment recommendations and to evidence campaign performance versus expected outcomes.</li> <li>Spearhead the integration of data analytics and insights into the core of our strategic planning processes, ensuring data is used proactively and upfront in all client engagements and internal initiatives.</li> <li>Accelerate AI adoption and transformation across the team, ensuring we are regularly sharing work and that clients see the tangible benefits of WPP Open.</li> <li>Take a lead role in developing and presenting best-in-class Strategic Response to Briefs (RTBs).</li> <li>Support ADs in delivering Media Detail RTBs and in briefing Activation teams.</li> <li>Work closely with the Head of Strategy &amp; Planning on wider cross-portfolio strategic workstreams.</li> <li>Oversee and quality assure all deliverables produced by junior team members.</li> <li>Work with Activation and Analytics in the delivery and measurement of plans.</li> <li>Take responsibility for the performance of assigned media budgets against intended outcomes.</li> <li>Be a point of escalation for team issues (within and outside the team).</li> <li>Contribute to internal thought leadership and team process/workflow enhancement, to increase work quality and efficiency.</li> <li>Line-manage 3 direct reports (AD, AM, SAE), supporting their career development and driving job satisfaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies (specific knowledge, skills and abilities)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced knowledge of media landscape, media metric calculations and measurement techniques.</li> <li>Thorough understanding of industry standard media research tools (ComScore, Touchpoints, TGI, YouGov).</li> <li>Demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources (e.g., market research, digital analytics, social listening, econometrics, CRM data, first-party data).</li> <li>Deep understanding of current market trends, consumer behaviour, and the evolving media landscape.</li> <li>Superb client relationship and management skills.</li> <li>Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and insights into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences. (internal teams, clients, senior leadership).</li> <li>Highly collaborative, comfortable working cross-functionally with data, analytics, research, and creative teams.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading, inspiring, and upskilling more junior planners, fostering a culture of curiosity and continuous learning.</li> <li>Excellent organisational skills, close attention to detail and ability to quality-control work.</li> <li>Forecast expected outcomes of brand and performance campaigns and manage investment accordingly.</li> <li>Basic spreadsheet capabilities (VLOOKUP, Pivot Table) are a must.</li> <li>Superior presentation design skills, in slides or document format.</li> <li>Ability to adhere to deadlines and project manage multiple campaigns.</li> <li>Development and maintenance of productive relationships with media owner partners.</li> <li>Proven problem solving and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and to collaborate in a team environment.</li> <li>Skilled in quantitative reasoning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Management Responsibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Motivate a team, leading by example while coaching juniors - cultivating a dynamic and inquisitive culture where hypothesis-driven thinking is central to problem-solving.</li> <li>Provide timely and actionable feedback to aid in team development and improvement.</li> <li>Monitor and support satisfaction across the team, identifying and implementing ways to maintain or increase satisfaction.</li> <li>Foster strong working relationships across the team to facilitate flawless execution of plans.</li> <li>Communicate effectively across all levels of the team, understanding when to escalate issues to leadership.</li> <li>Calculate the workload implication of new campaigns and feed into resource management.</li> <li>Provide awareness and recognition for jobs well done.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least six to eight years of experience in a pure planning role.</li> <li>Demonstrable interest and expertise in planning craft.</li> <li>Data literate with demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources.</li> <li>Mastery of planning/insight tools such as eTelmar, TGI, YouGov, WARC, etc.</li> <li>Strong experience and interest in dedicated planning tools.</li> <li>Interest and knowledge of Planning and Media trends and issues.</li> <li>Proven experience in media at Senior Manager level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.&nbsp;</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p> <p><strong>Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax</strong></p> <ul> <li>Location: Mon remotely, Tue-Fri in-office (London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, or Madrid)</li> <li>Reporting to: VP, Tax</li> <li>Reports: no formal direct reports, with broad influence on the global tax organization</li> </ul> <p>At Axon, we are on a mission to Protect Life. We build and deploy technology across public safety and justice, and we hold ourselves to high standards in how we operate — including in how we manage our obligations as a global business.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>Axon is seeking a Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax to lead the company's international VAT and indirect tax function, encompassing all non-US VAT and indirect taxes. The role carries overall responsibility for the quality and accuracy of all indirect tax compliance output, as well as providing advisory support to internal teams on indirect tax matters arising from contracts, new market entry, entity set-up, and tax law changes.</p> <p>The successful candidate will be commercially minded, technically strong across European and global VAT systems, experienced in indirect tax compliance, and confident advising Finance, Legal, and Commercial colleagues without requiring escalation. The role supervises three indirect tax team members, reporting directly to the Vice President, Tax.&nbsp; Experience in a hardware and software business with a complex supply chain is highly desired.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for non-US indirect tax queries across Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams.</li> <li>Liaise with sales teams and other partners to understand upstream sales processes that impact indirect tax operationalization and compliance matters.</li> <li>Advise on the VAT treatment of customer contracts, pricing structures, and invoicing arrangements, working directly with Sales and Legal as required.</li> <li>Provide VAT guidance on new product lines and SKU launches, including taxability assessments and sales tax code assignments in D365.</li> <li>Represent the indirect tax function in e-invoicing projects and regulatory change programmes.</li> <li>Support the business through tax authority audits, enquiries, and disputes.</li> <li>Monitor legislative developments across relevant jurisdictions and communicate implications to the business.</li> <li>Advise and inform management on growing areas of focus in non-US indirect compliance and audits, technology trends and solutions, and process improvements.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and approve all indirect tax compliance deliverables — VAT returns, Intrastat, OSS, and ESL — across all in-scope jurisdictions, with full accountability for accuracy and submission deadlines.</li> <li>Oversee indirect tax accounting, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and BlackLine certification.</li> <li>Maintain the compliance calendar and validate data quality across all submissions.</li> <li>Monitor VAT payments and refunds; liaise with local tax authorities where required.</li> <li>Provide guidance to Finance and operational teams on compliance requirements as they arise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>New Entity Set-Up</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the indirect tax workstream for all new entity formations, covering VAT registration, system readiness, and the preparation of compliant workpaper frameworks prior to first filing.</li> <li>Review and approve invoice templates for new entities before they commence trading.</li> <li>Ensure SOX and internal control obligations are met across all indirect tax processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and Systems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and implement improvements to VAT filing workflows, including the use of AI, macros, Alteryx, and D365 configuration.</li> <li>Participate in or lead system testing for indirect tax-related ERP and reporting changes.</li> <li>Maintain commodity code tax tables and item sales tax code frameworks in D365.</li> <li>Ensure processes are documented and structured to support an expanding compliance footprint.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 10 years' experience in VAT or indirect tax, gained in-house at a multinational or in a professional services environment.</li> <li>Detailed working knowledge of VAT across multiple European jurisdictions, including Intrastat, OSS, and ESL reporting obligations.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience reviewing and approving compliance deliverables prepared by others, with personal accountability for quality and timeliness.</li> <li>Experience advising on the indirect tax treatment of commercial contracts, pricing arrangements, and customer invoicing.</li> <li>Experience managing the indirect tax aspects of new entity set-ups, including VAT registration and process build-out.</li> <li>Familiarity with Microsoft D365 or a comparable ERP; working knowledge of BlackLine, Sigma, and Alteryx is advantageous.</li> <li>Understanding of SOX internal control requirements in a tax context.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly on technical VAT matters to non-specialist colleagues across Legal, Finance, and Commercial functions.</li> <li>Experience managing and leading a team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. title: Senior Platform Engineer (Remote UK Only)
description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads. This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.   What You'll Be Doing BAU & Platform Stability Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes. Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments. Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes. Kubernetes  Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability. Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management. Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems. Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery. raw.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Remote UK Only)
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.
