description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u>.</p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p></p> <h3><strong>Backend Engineer - Platform - Stacks</strong></h3> <p><strong>This role is available for candidates located in the UK, Germany, Spain, Ireland and Sweden.</strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise.</p> <p>The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts.</p> <p>This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <p>The AppCore Stacks squad owns the systems that create, configure, reconcile, migrate, and operate Grafana Cloud stacks at scale. A stack is the customer-facing Grafana Cloud environment that connects an organization to Grafana and the backend services it uses, including Mimir, Loki, Tempo, plugins, dashboards, data sources, and stack-level configuration.</p> <p>Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and operations. We build the control-plane services and workflows that keep stack state aligned across grafana.com, Stack State Service (SSS), Hosted Grafana, cloud regions, and the underlying Grafana Cloud infrastructure. When this domain works well, customers get reliable stack creation, safe configuration rollout, predictable migrations, and fewer manual operational interventions.</p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate reconciliation systems, including the SSS backend, to track desired stack state, detect and repair drift across stack templates, grafana.com state, Hosted Grafana, and actual customer stack configuration</li> <li>Collaborate across SSS, grafana.com, and deployment configurations to ensure stack lifecycle workflows remain reliable, observable, and resilient</li> <li>Improve operational efficiency by reducing deployment complexity (e.g., aiming for single PR regional SSS deployment) and contributing to the Stack Config Reconciliation project</li> <li>Manage rollout mechanisms for provisioned plugins, dashboards, data sources, Grafana versions, release channels, and stack-level configuration</li> <li>Support new region and cluster rollouts, including the operational paths required to bring stacks online safely in new Grafana Cloud regions</li> <li>Improve incident response and recovery paths for stack misalignment, reconciliation failures, plugin rollout issues, and Hosted Grafana integration failures</li> <li>Partner with Product, Hosted Grafana, Infrastructure, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads on customer-impacting stack lifecycle work</li> <li>Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations</li> <li>You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <p>At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe.</p> <p>We are seeking a Backend Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and operational clarity are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain.</p> <p>You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.</p> <p>Some things you might be expected to do could include:</p> <ul> <li>Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code</li> <li>Implementing new microservices or systems</li> <li>Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions</li> <li>Coordinating with product and UX when needed</li> <li>Responding to customer requests and feedback</li> <li>When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation</li> <li>Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience</li> <li>You have some experience working on a SaaS platform and are familiar with common distributed systems concepts (e.g., scalability, multi-tenancy, HA).</li> <li>Have professional experience with Golang and be willing to work across both backend service and application code</li> <li>Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on</li> <li>Have some experience contributing to the delivery of projects, from initial brainstorming to shipping a product to the customer.</li> <li>You write clean, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain</li> <li>Can take on well-defined tasks, break them down, and execute iteratively to deliver working title: Admin Services - Senior Country Commercial Manager - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2>About the team&nbsp;</h2> <p>The Admin Services commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners.&nbsp; This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company Secretariat services.&nbsp; Most of these are sold on a subscription basis, providing consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. &nbsp; The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention.&nbsp;</p> <h2>About the role<strong>&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Country Commercial Manager to drive revenue growth from our Invoicing and Expense Management products, as well as leading on our Accountant GTM. You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function, and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand product performance, uncover opportunities, and work across multiple areas to deliver.&nbsp; This will require a relentless focus on the numbers and our members, product prioritisation, and detailed planning to ensure revenue targets are hit and customer lifetime value is always increasing.<br><br>In this role, you will be responsible for the strategy and implementation of core activities to drive activation and usage of Invoicing and Expense Management as well as unlocking growth out of Accountants. This includes close partnership with marketing teams to ensure seamless delivery of ‘always on’ campaign activity.&nbsp; This role will also own the strategy and launch approach for new product launches, ensuring that all channels and member touch points are considered.&nbsp; This includes end-to-end journeys and transaction channels.&nbsp; You’ll need to partner effectively with multiple stakeholders to make this happen – excellent organisation and communication skills essential.</p> <p><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership &amp; Forecasting</strong>: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine financial projections for Invoicing, Expense Management and Accountants, ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Analytics-Driven Insight: </strong>with the support of the BI team you will analyse member behaviour, segment audiences, and measure subscription cohort&nbsp; performance. You will then translate this data into clear recommendations that shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.</li> <li><strong>Product Development: </strong>Leveraging the commercial and analytics insights, you will partner with the Product teams to address areas of opportunity.&nbsp; This will include shaping product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting&nbsp; successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.</li> <li><strong>Launch Strategy</strong>: &nbsp; You’ll support new feature launches across channels, partnering with excellent sales, and operations teams to deliver best-in-class experiments.&nbsp; You’ll facilitate brainstorm sessions / workshops to surface creative ideas and implementation plans.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:&nbsp; </strong>As you’ll be working in a highly collaborative way, it will be key to communicate regularly with a wide range of stakeholders.&nbsp; This will include Tide’s Senior Leadership Team as well as the C-Suite.</li> <li><strong>Commercial &amp; Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter. 

Our commitment to you:
At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights. 

The opportunity:

As a Senior Sales Development Representative (Sr. SDR), you will play a critical role in driving pipeline generation and revenue growth across the EMEA region. Building upon core sales development expertise, you will own strategic prospecting initiatives, develop targeted account penetration strategies, and partner closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to create qualified opportunities within enterprise and mid-market organisations.
 
You will also serve as a role model and mentor to newer SDRs, sharing best practices and helping elevate overall team performance.

How you will shape sales development at Achievers:
  • Generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting across assigned EMEA territories.
  • Conduct research and account mapping to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and buying committees within target organisations.
  • Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across prospective accounts to increase account penetration and create new business opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and drive pipeline growth.
  • Create and execute targeted outreach campaigns leveraging phone, email, social selling, and other prospecting channels.
  • Maintain accurate accounts, opportunities, and activity data within Salesforce and other sales engagement platforms.
  • Stay informed on EMEA market trends, competitive activity, and industry developments to enhance prospecting effectiveness and account strategies.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed pipeline generation, meeting creation, and activity targets.
  • Share best practices and provide guidance to less experienced SDR team members, contributing to overall team success.
  • Demonstrate a multithreading approach into large key accounts.
  • Outline using AI to streamline prospecting
  • Process and create efficiencies in workflow

    • Experience we feel will set you up for success:
  • 18+ months of experience in a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or similar prospecting role with a track record of achieving or exceeding targets.
  • Strong understanding of outbound prospecting and lead qualifications.
  • Proven ability to engage and build relationships with stakeholders at multiple levels within an organisation.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools such as Outreach, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar technologies.
  • Strong organisational, prioritisation, and time management skills.
  • Results-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience prospecting within the EMEA market and an understanding of regional business practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to share best practices and positively contribute to team performance and culture.

    • Why join our team:
  • Join a team of high-performance consistent 100%+ quota teammates
  • Additional holiday allowance on top of statutory days which we call ‘Achievers Reward Days’.
  • Team lunches and global company updates which means a chance for collaboration and connection outside of your day-to-day
  • Pension, Life Assurance, Private Medical + Wellbeing benefits
  • Technology & Cycle Scheme
  • Buy up to 5 days extra holiday each year
  • Hybrid working culture
  • 2 volunteering/community activity days per year
    • Why you’ll love working at Achievers:
    ✨ We are passionate about disruptive technology that’s rooted in science, research and data.
    ✨ We understand the value of employee success in the workplace and have been recognized in numerous publications for our contributions to HR, for technical excellence, and for our outstanding workplace culture!
    ✨ We foster an environment of connection, security, and community. You’ll feel at home, without reservation. 
    ✨ We believe in moving quickly, failing fast, and adapting to change. 
    ✨ We enjoy coming to work every day because we believe in our product and love our culture.
    ✨ We’re committed to achieving excellence in everything we do.

Our hybrid work experience is designed to cultivate an engaging employee experience, where pioneering research intersects with cutting-edge technology. We strongly believe that collocating teams increases the chance to innovate together, foster passive learning, create spontaneous connections, and promote better communication.

All qualification will be done face-to-face, whether that is in person or over Zoom. Achievers does not send out offers of employment without meeting candidates and does not offer employment via text. If you are requested for any personal information via text and/or without having met a member of our hiring team in person, please disregard.

    Our employees are a diverse and inclusive team of passionate, hardworking individuals. Achievers is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an environment where our employees can do the best work of their lives. We encourage all qualified candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply to join our A-Player family.  

    Achievers is committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. title: Senior Grab Crane Operative, Smugglers Way MRF
description: Step into a vital position at our Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) in Smugglers Way, Wandsworth. This is a fast‑paced, hands‑on operational role at the heart of London’s recycling system. Every day, you’ll be helping turn thousands of tonnes of commingled recyclables into high‑quality materials ready for reprocessing — ensuring that the city’s waste is handled safely, efficiently, and sustainably. As a Senior Grab Crane Operative, you’ll take ownership of managing and maintaining bunker levels, coordinating material arriving by dustcart for processing in the MRF. You’ll be the go‑to person for overseeing junior and agency operatives, giving direction, offering guidance, and ensuring everyone works to the highest safety and operational standards. You’ll also play a key role in liaising with TAC Control, Shift Supervisors and sampling teams to keep material quality high and operations flowing smoothly. Effective communication and calm decision‑making will be essential, especially in a busy environment where no two days look the same. This role also brings opportunities to contribute to wider operational planning — from resource allocation and maintenance coordination to supporting the smooth running of the site. You’ll be central to maintaining a safe, organised and high‑performing facility that helps keep London’s recycling moving. Please note: This role is Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 22:00. We’re looking for someone with experience in a similar environment — preferably within recycling, MRF operations or an engineering‑based setting. You should be comfortable making decisions in a high‑pressure operational setting, with a strong understanding of safe working practices and statutory requirements. Being a team player is essential. You’ll be guiding junior operatives, supporting colleagues across the facility, and ensuring that daily check sheets, paperwork and handovers are completed clearly and on time. Strong communication skills will help you keep everything running smoothly. You’ll need the willingness to work flexibly, including additional hours or alternative shifts as required. A practical mindset, hands‑on attitude and readiness to assist with wider site tasks — including cleaning and maintenance duties — will make you a great fit. If you’re driven, reliable and motivated by making a difference in essential environmental operations, you’ll thrive in this role and become a valued part of an experienced and dedicated team. Who you are

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data.

Security and Elgibility Requirement
